disorder.text: Cause and effect domain: disorder. The navigator cannot tell which domain applies. The book's move for disorder is to slice: break the situation into parts and place each part in its own domain before choosing a move. The host model decides how to use the shortlist.
disorder.book_heading: Each domain asks for a different order of verbs

chaotic.text: Cause and effect domain: chaotic. No command on this install is an act-first move, so there is no strong pick. Act to make the situation stable first, then look again.
